references.text: Refers to the event where Jesus feeds five thousand men, plus women and children, with five loaves and two fish, and they gather twelve baskets of leftovers.
Describes a similar event in Mark where Jesus feeds five thousand men with five loaves and two fish.
Luke's version of the event where Jesus feeds five thousand men with five loaves and two fish.
John's detailed description of the miracle where Jesus feeds five thousand men with five barley loaves and two small fish.
